business_summary: Natural Food International Holding Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells natural health food products in China. It sells its products through a network of offline channels, including supermarket counter business and offline shelf business, as well as online channels, including major e-commerce platforms and WeChat member stores. The company was formerly known as Roomy Development Holdings Limited and changed its name to Natural Food International Holding Limited in May 2018. Natural Food International Holding Limited was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Natural Food International Holding Limited는 중국에서 자연 건강 식품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 대형 전자상거래 플랫폼, 위챗 가맹점 등 온라인 채널은 물론, 슈퍼마켓 카운터 사업, 오프라인 매대 사업 등 오프라인 채널 네트워크를 통해 제품을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에는 Roomy Development Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2018년 5월에 Natural Food International Holding Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Natural Food International Holding Limited는 2007년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
